title: Obsidian Strenght - Gym Website
description: A modern fitness website designed for gyms and personal trainers featuring responsive layouts, pricing sections, and strong branding.
fullDescription: This Gym Website project showcases a complete fitness center online presence with membership plans, trainer profiles, class schedules, and contact forms. Built with responsive design principles to work seamlessly on all devices. The site features an intuitive navigation structure, compelling imagery, and clear call-to-action buttons to drive member signups and class registrations.
designGoals: Create a professional fitness center brand presence
Showcase membership plans and pricing clearly
Build trust with trainer profiles and testimonials
Optimize for mobile fitness enthusiast browsing

title: Ethereal - Fashion Store Concept
description: Ethereal is a fashion-focused eCommerce concept designed to showcase modern streetwear products with a clean shopping experience, responsive layouts, and visually engaging product sections.
fullDescription: This eCommerce Store features a complete online shopping experience with product filtering, shopping cart functionality, secure checkout, and customer reviews. Optimized for conversions with strategic call-to-action buttons throughout. The design emphasizes product showcase with high-quality images, detailed product descriptions, customer testimonials, and a seamless checkout process to maximize sales.
